ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominantly low-intensity (dark) with minimal high-intensity (white) regions; estimated macro-level ratio of high:low intensity pixels is approximately 0.05:0.95.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous dark substrate across both lobes. Fine-grained, high-contrast white focal spots are distributed across the mid-region of the right lobe and near the upper margin of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow U-shaped central depression with a wide, obtuse internal angle; vertical depth is minimal relative to the horizontal span of the fluke lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Asymmetrical serration. The right lobe trailing edge displays 5-7 distinct peaks and valleys of moderate amplitude. The left lobe edge is comparatively more linear with lower-frequency, low-amplitude wave-like variations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave upward curvature (parabolic sweep) originating from the median notch and tapering towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized, dense clusters of high-intensity white pixels at the extreme distal tips of both lobes, exhibiting roughly circular morphology consistent with barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several thin, non-parallel white linear disruptions are detected; one prominent diagonal mark is visible on the right lobe and a smaller vertical mark near the center of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive white scarring and organic protrusions localized on the trailing edge tips; a distinct irregular indentation is visible on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: The localization of high-contrast scarring exclusively to the fluke tips against a nearly uniform dark ventral surface is a primary distinctive feature.
